reviews.text: An amazing job done! Before and after pics attached! I’ve been struggling to find someone to groom my guy Harvey because he doesn’t allow anyone to touch him. Sinead was so patient with him and always puts the dog first. Harvey doesn’t like crates so she made sure he wouldn’t have to be in one. She doesn’t do anything the dog doesn’t like. Her own dog Larry was such a great comfort to Harvey and she went at Harvey’s pace. Harvey came out happy and looking amazing! I just wanted Harvey to not have any knots, I would have settled with anything but Sinead went above and beyond and brought him out looking like a model. Thank you so much we will definitely be becoming a regular! 🐶
Sinead always does a great job, My little Cody always looks fab.
